profile.headline: Senior Full-Stack Engineer | Agentic AI Engineer
profile.summary:
Full-Stack Architecture & System Design. I design and deliver high-load systems across FinTech, E-Commerce, and Enterprise AI, alongside launching independent products from scratch — translating business goals into reliable web, mobile, and backend solutions.

Technical Leadership & Agentic AI. I lead engineering teams and build end-to-end delivery workflows powered by a Spec-Driven approach and AI agents, enabling businesses to validate hypotheses faster and ship complex products with lean teams without compromising quality.

experience.title: Senior Full-Stack & Agentic AI Engineer
experience.description: Build proprietary products and NDA commercial projects across mobile apps, web services, Telegram Mini Apps, and bots. Lead the engineering team, write code on critical paths, and structure development workflows around AI agents.
achievements: **Agentic AI:** Configured project-specific AI Harness setups (rules, skills, hooks, MCP) and subagent pipelines. Transitioned the team to a Spec-Driven workflow from design to automated tests and review, speeding up feature delivery by 2–3x.

**Mobile Development:** Architected from scratch and launched 4 apps on the App Store and Google Play — component development following SRP/SOLID principles, native and intuitive UX, custom animations, offline mode and background sync, payment gateways, and in-app purchases.

**Web Development:** Designed and engineered frontend and backend systems with a focus on performance and code quality — communication via REST or real-time streaming, LLM integration into business workflows, billing, and payment processing.
**Authentication & Security:** Engineered authentication systems powered by Supabase and Firebase Auth (OAuth 2.0, SSO, JWT, RBAC) with native Apple/Google Sign-In and seamless Telegram login.

**Multi-Cloud CI/CD & Releases:** Automated build and release pipelines via GitHub Actions, Codemagic, and Docker — covering cloud infrastructure deployment (GCP, Oracle Cloud, Cloudflare) and automated publishing to the App Store and Google Play.
experience.stack: Agentic Factories, Harness & Context Engineering, Spec-Driven Development, MCP, System Design, DDD & Clean Architecture, TypeScript, Flutter, React & Next.js (SSR/SSG), Node.js, NestJS, PostgreSQL, Prisma, Redis, Supabase, Firebase, WebSockets, Telegram Mini Apps (TMA SDK), OAuth 2.0, Docker, GitHub Actions, Codemagic, GCP, Oracle Cloud, Cloudflare, ASO, SEO.
